release_gate.required: Explicit primary code/protocol-freeze release before any fresh query, candidate inspection or acquisition. Primary release receipt must bind preparation.READY SHA256, verbatim release message/locator, implementation and policy freeze hashes, and timestamp/timezone.

source_strata.general_comment: Complete proposed rulemaking notice inviting comments, without qualifying conditional/event-relative participation or hearing timing. Fixed dates and absent fields both allowed.
source_strata.conditional_control: Natural source condition on comment submission timing or hearing availability/request threshold, conditional cancellation of a proposed-rule hearing, or event-relative participation timing. A generic submission-format practicability qualifier, accessibility request, possible later rule modification or incidental quoted statute alone does not qualify. Fixed written-comment dates may coexist with a conditional hearing. No negative lifecycle-only controls in this round.
source_strata.precedence: Actual source category governs quota, regardless of query planned stratum. These are sampling categories, not reference answers.

selection: Sequential bounded displayed-result order. Do not select for substantive deadline/email/channel/clock/timezone field presence, exact values, ease of parsing, outputs or verifier behavior. Missing fields remain eligible; only predeclared control stratum may depend on participation/lifecycle terms.
scope: Accept only complete unchanged official publisher individual notice PDFs or a single complete publisher regulation filing that includes its notice and required integrated filing sections. A coherent individual proposed rule order is eligible including judicial rulemaking. Publisher labeling alone does not establish completeness: record mechanical opening/continuation/end boundaries for one proceeding. Reject multi-notice register issues, mixed packets, unrelated attachments, scans without native text, slice/unknown scopes. Several coordinated rules within one single notice are allowed. Never invent notice boundaries or remove pages.

native_caps.utf8: strict nonempty UTF-8; no replacement characters or material native-text damage; FF count must equal all PDF pages
native_caps.extractor: pdftotext -layout -enc UTF-8; exact bytes; no OCR, repair, reflow, truncation or excerpt
native_caps.validation_order: Check all native/PDF/page budgets and dedup before any retention. Native acquisition is not provisional selection. Serialized case-size eligibility remains for primary runtime freeze; no runtime case generation in collector.

quota_rule: At most one retained notice per state until six distinct states are retained, then at most two. Before acceptance require current 6-general/2-control capacity, total<8, aggregate pages<=40 and six-state feasibility. First qualifying chronological candidate wins. No imagined future-source reservation or output-based replacement.
discovery: First three distinct direct official PDF/document URLs in displayed result order; citation IDs are not ranks. Full raw response and all metadata preserved and independently reconciled before registration. No HTML-link expansion, rerun, alternate query, or replacement search. A known prior URL still consumes its bounded slot and is excluded without reacquisition.
access: Public web search and ordinary HTTP only; no paid Firecrawl/API source access. Maximum two60-second ordinary attempts per bounded candidate; retain both attempts including partial bytes, HTTP headers/errors/timestamps. No retry after success, bypass, alternate URLs or hidden retrieval. Prior URL/hash exclusions consume slots. No application/benchmark parser, model/provider API, OCR or labels calls, and no credentials. Mechanical local native PDF tools (strict pypdf parsing, Poppler diagnostics/extraction/rendering) are allowed.
stopping: Success at exact eight, six general plus two controls, >=six states, <=two/state and <=40 pages. Otherwise after Q24 bounded candidates stop and disclose shortfall. No replacements after source freeze.
artifacts: Preserve all exclusions and acquired originals/diagnostics/native bytes. Retained input PDF byte-identical to original. Render every retained page at150DPI. Hash all artifacts and each PNG; preserve versions, acquisition timestamps UTC, official URL, HTTP, identity/boundary/dedup evidence and source anomalies. Keep selection audit outside runtime and blind inventory.

blinded_image_inventory.excludes: native text, URLs, titles, source categories, candidate decisions, expected fields, evidence hints, decisive spans, labels and runtime outputs. All pages only; IDs match opaque runtime IDs.

audit_limits: Native-only, individual-publisher-PDF and frozen-search-ranking coverage biases disclosed.
Natural controls only; no synthetic controls or provider-assisted collection.
prior_rounds: Immutable; dedup includes all known originals and excluded bytes; no labels consulted.
mime_policy: Accept application/pdf or application/octet-stream only when bytes begin %PDF- and strict pypdf parsing succeeds with >=1 page; both are eligible MIME types, not proof of full notice. HTML, redirects outside official query domain, corrupt PDFs, other MIME types and access failures are excluded honestly. Preserve originals/headers/errors without access bypass.
body_coverage: Nonempty captions/headers do not establish body coverage. Before retention record per-page substantive body presence in exact native text, compare native text with a full source-only visual check of every original page at150DPI, and affirm all substantive body/table/footnote/continuation/end matter is represented. Images/scans with missing substantive native body fail even if captions exist. No OCR, repair, truncation or reconstruction. Blank/decorative pages may be recorded explicitly. If material coverage is uncertain, exclude.
dedup: Use frozen historical hash, URL, exact native and normalized-text inventories; manual underlying notice identity comparison against prior source identities required even when mechanical tests pass. A register containing a previously seen individual notice may not supply that notice under new bytes. New publication date alone is insufficient. Unknown novelty => exclude.
control_definition_change_from_round6: Stricter source sampling rule: the Round6 New Hampshire alternative electronic submission-format practicability qualifier alone is not sufficient. Only actual conditional/event-relative participation timing or hearing availability qualifies. This precollection change is independent of model performance and does not revise any prior-round artifact.
